android.desc:
Agile Tasks is a tiny Kanban board for the lists in your head.
Three columns — Todo, Doing, Done — and one motion: swipe right when
you start something, swipe again when it's finished. That's the whole
app. No projects-within-projects, no labels, no priorities, no
"inbox to triage" — just where things are right now.

It's the app for everyone who wants Trello without the meetings.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• MOVE WITH A FLICK
  Swipe right on a card to push it forward, swipe left to push it
  back. Tap any card to edit it where it sits — no pop-ups, no extra
  screens, no "save and close."

• SECTIONS FOR EVERY PART OF LIFE
  Work, House, Kids, Side Project — group your day however it
  actually splits. Collapse a section when you don't want to look at
  it. Drag whole sections between projects.

• DONE EVAPORATES
  Finished tasks auto-delete on a window you set — 24 hours, a week,
  a month, never. They sit in Recently Deleted for 30 days if you
  change your mind. No more "Done" column of receipts from January.

• FULLY OFFLINE
  Your tasks live on your device the moment you open the app. No
  account required. No internet required. Sign in only when you want
  to sync, and only if you want to.

• SYNC ACROSS DEVICES (PRO)
  Sign in once and your board shows up on every device — phone,
  laptop (agiletasks.app), tablet — with real-time updates and
  conflict-free merging. Pro is $14.99/year or $34 once.

• SHARE PROJECTS
  Invite anyone to collaborate on a shared board. Edits sync in real
  time. The other person doesn't need Pro to join — only the project
  owner does.

• HOME-SCREEN WIDGET
  A 4×3 widget pinned to a project, a column, or a single section so
  the day's list is one glance away.

• NATURAL-LANGUAGE DUE DATES
  Type "tomorrow 3pm" or "Friday morning" into a task and Agile Tasks
  offers to set the reminder. Backed by daily / weekly / monthly /
  yearly native recurrence.

• CHECKBOXES INSIDE TASKS
  Break a task into checkbox steps inside its description. Tick the
  last box and the card flies itself to Done.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHO IT'S FOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If Trello feels like a project-management app and you wanted a task
app — you wanted this.

If you've tried Things, Todoist, TickTick, Microsoft To Do and
bounced because list-of-lists doesn't show you "what am I in the
middle of?" — you wanted this.

quotes.text: This is the perfect android kanban like App I've used with intuitive UI: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sauce.agile&hl=en
quotes.story_title: Taskbook: Like Trello but for the Terminal
